doc: lon = arctan2(y, x), lat = arcsin(clip(z, -1, 1)), float64. The poles (x = y = +0.0: lon 0), the antimeridian (-1, +0.0, 0: lon = +pi), z beyond +-1 (1.0000001, -1.5, 2: clipped, no NaN), vectors that are NOT unit length (arctan2 ignores the length, arcsin uses z as is), the zero vector (lon 0, lat 0), tiny and huge components, a point 1e-12 below the pole (arcsin is ill-conditioned there: the input is exact, so only the implementation matters). Closed form: rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-12.
